_doc: Project anchor for this design system's Figma integration. Single source of truth for which Figma file we read from. Maps in maps/*.json resolve their `source` keys against this file. Never hard-code a file key in a script or a skill — read it from here, so pointing the system at a different file is one edit.

bridges._doc: TWO bridges, recorded separately. Nothing in `pnpm verify` or CI depends on either, so the repo is green on a machine with no Figma tooling installed. Code stays canonical for token values in both directions; a difference is drift in Figma, never a change to adopt back.

read._doc: The official Figma MCP connector. No daemon, no plugin, no Figma Desktop.

write._doc: figma-console MCP driving the Desktop Bridge plugin. OPT-IN: no script or gate in this repo invokes it. The three ds-figma-* skills in .claude/skills/ write through it; they were imported from the template and are not adapted to this repo yet. Every write must first compare `figma.fileKey` against sources.<key>.key and pin the target with `figma_navigate({ url, lock: true })`.
requires: Desktop Bridge plugin open in the target file

main._doc: Linked on 2026-11-14. Its variables were read on 2026-11-14 and are recorded in maps/tokens.json; no component has been read. The source key `main` is what maps/*.json point at.
main.name: ds-monorepo
main.purpose: The design source for this system.

identity._doc: The package scope and the CSS / data-attribute prefixes live in /ds.config.json and are not repeated here.

variableNaming._doc: How a Figma variable name maps to a token. Measured on 2026-11-14 from the plugin API (all 183 local variables, 11 collections). No variable has a code syntax set, so `name` is the only name there is.
variableNaming.rule: Token path = the collection's root group, then the variable name lower-cased with `/` replaced by `.`. Colour collections share the root group `color`; every other collection's root group is its own name in kebab-case.
knownProblems: Variable names are not unique across collections: `16` exists in Spacing, Size, Font size and Line height. A variable is identified by collection + name, and maps/tokens.json is keyed that way.
Opacity variables hold a percentage (0-100); the tokens hold the same opacity as a 0-1 number. The values differ by a factor of 100 by design.
`bg/backdrop` is the one Color semantic variable that is a raw value rather than an alias, because an alias cannot carry alpha.

variableCollections._doc: Figma collection -> canonical token source file under packages/tokens/tokens/. A Figma variable whose collection has no entry here resolves to `code: null` in maps/tokens.json and is reported as drift. Color semantic has two modes and so two files, one per mode.

codePathConvention._doc: Where a Figma component's code counterpart lives. UNDECIDED until packages/react has a folder layout.
